scenes.text: Have you ever wondered why purple was the ultimate color of royalty?
In ancient Rome, only emperors could wear this specific shade, known as Tyrian purple, but making it required harvesting twelve thousand sea snails.
These snails were left to rot in giant vats under the baking sun, creating a stench so foul that the entire city smelled like rotting fish.
Would you wear this stinky fabric just to show off your wealth and status?
